from pathlib import Path
import sys,json,tempfile
root=Path('C:/Users/dfred/Desktop/Projects/IGH/quantyra-wormhole-semiclassical')
sys.path[:0]=[str(root/'checks'),'C:/Users/dfred/AppData/Local/Temp/s169af-arb']
import current_schur_scalar_projection as s
from flint import arb,ctx
ctx.prec=512
p,h,zh,env=s.prev.york.actual_parameters();C=p['C'];B2=p['B2'];lam=p['g'];x=lam*B2
z=s.prev.local.monomial;du=p['eps']*C/x;ee=1/(60*arb.pi());eta=ee*lam;DR=96*arb.pi()*arb('1e22');dl=(DR-ee)*lam
beta=x/C;v=1+h;thermal=v*h*h*(beta*(1+2/v+3/v**2)+1/(C*v**2)+p['eps']/v**4)
fa=4+2/x+thermal*C/x;fb=3+1/x+du
F=z(-2)+1/x-fa*z(1)+fb*z(2)-2*du*z(3)+du*z(4)
Dt=lambda f:-z(2)*f.derivative()
Lap=lambda f:z(4)*(F*f.derivative()).derivative()
r=4*z(5)-6*z(6);rn=-12+du*r
tn=(3+1/x+du)*z(4)-du*(5*z(5)-arb(9)/2*z(6))
cn=fa*z(3)-2*fb*z(4)+arb(20)/3*du*z(5)-5*du*z(6)
P=7*cn**2+arb(22)/3*tn**2-arb(11)/72*(rn**2-144)
Ps=2*(6+du)**2+arb(22)/3*(6+du)/x+arb(22)/3/x**2
S=ee*arb(p['q'])**2/(lam*B2*B2);tau=S*(-10*z(4)-20*z(5)+30*z(6))+eta*(P+Ps*r/2)-dl*du*Lap(r)
On=rn/2-2*tn;chi=16*arb.pi()*arb('1e22')*lam
known_shape=chi*(x/C)*(2*On*tau+2*F*Dt(Dt(tau))+2*(Dt(F)+4*z(1)*F)*Dt(tau)).integral(zh)
old=json.loads((root/'evidence/current-schur-scalar-projection.json').read_bytes())['runs'][-1]
known_scalar=s.prev.endpoint.raw.decode(next(row for row in old['numerics'] if row['kind']=='actual_canonical_scalar_projection')['known_areal_pairing'])
out={'scope':'exploratory known trace-only R2 shape terms; complete shape and full signed reduced source not evaluated','ordinary_formula':'Equation (5) current-seed-cold-action-defect multiplied by z^4 and integrated dz. Dt=-z^2 d/dz, O/lambda=rn/2-2tn. Retain finite thermal seed. Subtract from previous known scalar pairing. Unknown principal S_rest, f, density, transport and complete quantum Hessian are excluded explicitly, not set to zero.',
 'known_scalar':s.encoded(known_scalar),'known_R2_trace_shape':s.encoded(known_shape),'known_difference':s.encoded(known_scalar-known_shape),
 'full_signed_source_executed':False,'source_utf8':Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8')}
path=Path(tempfile.gettempdir())/'s169bd-local-probe.json';path.write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({k:str(v) for k,v in [('scalar',known_scalar),('shape',known_shape),('difference',known_scalar-known_shape)]}))
